projects.name: ShOS
projects.subtitle: x86 Operating System from Scratch
projects.title: ShOS - x86 Operating System from Scratch
projects.description: Architected a 32-bit x86 operating system from scratch in C and NASM Assembly featuring a Multiboot-compliant bootloader, VGA text driver (80x25), PS/2 keyboard driver, and RAM-based hierarchical filesystem with 20+ built-in shell commands and nano-like editor with save/load support. Tested on QEMU emulator.

projects.name: ScopeIntel
projects.subtitle: Attack Surface Management Platform
projects.title: ScopeIntel - Attack Surface Management Platform
projects.description: Enterprise-grade Attack Surface Management platform automating external asset discovery & infrastructure mapping. Engineered an async recon engine using Python semaphores and Nmap, reducing discovery latency by 80%. Features multi-source enumeration, CNAME takeover detection, interactive D3 force graphs, and automated PDF security audit reports.

projects.name: Moves
projects.subtitle: Medicine Delivery Platform
projects.title: Moves - Medicine Delivery Platform
projects.description: Full-stack quick-commerce medicine delivery application featuring real-time searchable medicine catalog, persistent cart engine, and administrator dispatch portal. Selected as one of 6 national finalists in the Infosys TechZooka Innovation Summit Hackathon 2024.

projects.name: opSync
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Collaborative Editor
projects.title: opSync - Real-Time Collaborative Editor
projects.description: Full-stack real-time collaborative document editor utilizing Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (Yjs) and WebSockets. Implements live multi-user cursor tracking, deterministic conflict resolution, version rollback snapshots, granular RBAC, and integrated chat.

projects.name: Campora OSS
projects.subtitle: Institution Management Platform
projects.title: Campora OSS - Institution Management Platform
projects.description: Open-source software suite for educational institutions, unifying academic records, attendance workflows, administrative governance, and campus services into an extensible modular platform architecture.
